summary: Natural Gas Services Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting two routine corporate events: (1) entry into an indemnification agreement with newly elected director John E. Jackson, and (2) results of the 2026 annual shareholder meeting where directors were elected, executive compensation was approved on an advisory basis, and the independent auditor was ratified. No special-situation transaction, acquisition, sale, tender offer, or strategic review was disclosed. The filing contains no deal terms, premiums, or shareholder votes on a merger or other extraordinary corporate action. This is a standard current report of ordinary governance matters.
